title.narrative: Integrated Tuberculosis Care and Prevention for enhancing case findings, health system strengthening and sustainability

description.narrative: Bangladesh - Tuberculosis - BRAC - BRAC. This program has the following goals: Reduce the incidence of TB (all forms) by 50% by 2025 and 90% by 2035 (from 2015 baseline figure). The objectives of this program are: By 2026, provide screening for TB, either through symptom screening or chest x-ray, to at least 18.87 million people.. By 2026, test at least 11.39 million people using rapid molecular diagnostic tools or microscopy.. By 2026, diagnose and initiate treatment among 11,387 TB patients from key and vulnerable groups and among high risk population.. By 2026, diagnose and treat 0.97 million and around 8000 clients for DS and DR TB respectively.. By 2026, expand tuberculosis /HIV comorbidities services by ensuring access to screening for HIV for 0.39 million TB patients.. By the end of 2026, provide TB preventive therapy to 0.55 million eligibles.. By the end of 2026, successfully treat 95% of DSTB patients and at least 80% of DRTB patients.. By the end of 2026, test at least 5.23 million presumptive TB with WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tools. By the end of 2026, achieve expansion the electronic recording and reporting system and LMIS to all public health centres providing TB services in the country.
